title: Recommender Decision Architecture + Claim-Unlock Spine
safe_claim: PulseDiscovery now has a unified recommender decision architecture connecting candidate generation, FAISS retrieval, ranking/reranking, fallback, serving, logging, exposure governance, claim boundaries, and future OPE logging, with interview-maximal but evidence-bounded claim wording.
served_model_spine: c2_als.pkl (ALS f64) — stages 1-5 all run on c2; d3aplus quarantined to V1 tuning
comparability_rule: d3aplus 0.0846 and c2 ~0.0375 are NOT_COMPARABLE_ACROSS_PROTOCOLS; never substitute.

safe_with_boundary: cold-start handled at system level (no live-launch evidence)

ope_logging.validity_rule: No valid IPS/SNIPS/DR claim until pi_log and reward are populated from a logging-policy serving run with exploration.
ope_logging.first_estimator: SNIPS (variance control), then DR after a reward model

g26_quarantine.rule: G26 mitigation built & measured but NOT licensed; do not claim long-tail solved; do not call heuristic rerankers a learned LTR.

interview_answer_template: I built X, measured Y, learned Z, decided W, and the next evidence needed for the production claim is Q.
forbidden_claims: valid IPS/SNIPS/DR before propensities are logged
next_gate: G26B — unblock + integrate the built exposure-aware reranking onto the consolidated spine (offline-shaped); then OPE-logging execution gate.
